title: Feature snapshot columns (features/{date}/{group}.parquet, D31/D50)
description: GENERATED from features/registry.py::CATALOG by features/gen_parquet_contract.py -- do not hand-edit; regenerate with `python3 features/gen_parquet_contract.py --write`. One trading day's snapshot as {group: [row, ...]}: each property is one features/{date}/{group}.parquet file and each item one parquet row (DataFrame.to_dict('records'), NaN as null). Producer: features/writer.py::snapshot_group_frames (D31 daily, D50 settled regrade). Consumers pin a copy: crucible-research scoring/factor_scoring.py and crucible-dashboard views/13_Feature_Store.py (alpha-engine-config-I10793). features/registry.json is a SEPARATE artifact with its own contract, contracts/feature_registry.schema.json.

date.description: The snapshot's trading day, YYYY-MM-DD (the {date} path segment).

macd_line_last.description: MACD line value (fast EMA - slow EMA)

avg_volume_20d.description: Predictor input: 20-day avg volume / per-ticker global mean (relative liquidity ratio, ~1.0 typical). See features/SCHEMA.md for the bare-name == normalized convention.

avg_volume_20d_raw.description: Research scanner input: 20-day avg volume in raw shares. Absolute-liquidity gate consumer (MIN_AVG_VOLUME=500_000). The _raw suffix encodes units per features/SCHEMA.md.

sector_vs_spy_5d.description: 5-day sector ETF return minus SPY return

sector_vs_spy_10d.description: 10-day sector ETF return minus SPY return

sector_vs_spy_20d.description: 20-day sector ETF return minus SPY return

sub_sector_vs_benchmark_5d.description: 5-day sub-sector benchmark ETF (SMH/IGV/…) return minus SPY return; falls back to sector ETF for unmapped sub-industries (config#934)

sub_sector_vs_benchmark_10d.description: 10-day sub-sector benchmark ETF (SMH/IGV/…) return minus SPY return; falls back to sector ETF for unmapped sub-industries (config#934)

sub_sector_vs_benchmark_20d.description: 20-day sub-sector benchmark ETF (SMH/IGV/…) return minus SPY return; falls back to sector ETF for unmapped sub-industries (config#934)

realized_vol_63d.description: 63-day (3-month) annualized return std dev — slower vol regime than 20d, pairs as vol-term-structure

obv_slope_10d.description: OBV linear regression slope over 10 days

vwap_divergence_pct.description: (Close - VWAP) / VWAP, decimal pct — NaN when VWAP is unavailable (yfinance-fallback rows, Polygon outage windows)

cmf_20_ratio.description: Chaikin Money Flow (20d): rolling_sum(money_flow_multiplier * Volume, 20) / rolling_sum(Volume, 20). Bounded ~[-1, 1] dimensionless ratio; High==Low guarded to NaN.

overnight_return_5d.description: 5d sum of overnight returns (Open_t vs Close_{t-1})

intraday_return_5d.description: 5d sum of intraday returns (Close_t vs Open_t)

dist_from_5d_high.description: (Close - 5d rolling max High) / 5d rolling max High

dist_from_20d_high.description: (Close - 20d rolling max High) / 20d rolling max High

beta_60d.description: 60d rolling regression slope of stock log-returns vs SPY log-returns (systematic market exposure)

idio_vol_60d.description: 60d residual vol after removing beta exposure; std × sqrt(252) (idiosyncratic risk)

vol_of_vol_30d.description: 30d rolling stdev of realized_vol_20d (stability of vol regime)

max_drawdown_60d.description: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown within trailing 60d window (non-positive decimal pct)

residual_momentum_ratio.description: Vol-scaled cumulative residual (idiosyncratic) log-return over the 12-1 skip-month window: ∑resid_ret[t-252,t-21] / (σ_resid·√231) — an information ratio (Blitz/Hanauer residual momentum)

mom_12_1_pct.description: 12-1 skip-month raw price momentum: close.shift(21)/close.shift(252) - 1 (classic momentum factor, skips the recent-month reversal)

sector_mom_pct.description: The ticker's sector-ETF own 12-1 skip-month momentum (GKX industry momentum — absolute, distinct from sector_vs_spy_* relative features)

factor_momentum_ratio.description: Factor-momentum tilt (Gupta-Kelly): per date, dot the ticker's cross-sectionally z-scored factor loadings with each factor's trailing 12-1 long-short return momentum — Σ_f zscore(loading) × factor_mom. Dimensionless projection; backward-only (loadings at t × factor momentum through t-skip)

date.description: The snapshot's trading day, YYYY-MM-DD (the {date} path segment).

vix_term_slope.description: VIX spot vs VIX3M term structure slope, normalized

xsect_dispersion.description: Cross-sectional std dev of daily returns across universe

hy_oas_credit_spread_pct.description: ICE BofA US HY Index OAS (FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2), percent. License-gated to 2023+ on FRED; falls back to neutral 0.0 when unavailable.

payout_ratio.description: TTM dividends / net income (0-2 clipped); Stewardship pillar input — retention rate = 1 - payout drives reinvestment

dividend_yield.description: Indicated annual dividend yield (decimal, 0-0.2 clipped); Stewardship pillar input

capex_growth_5y.description: 5-year CAPEX growth (decimal); Stewardship pillar input — reinvestment intensity proxy

market_cap_raw.description: Raw market capitalization (absolute units, un-normalized) surfaced from Finnhub marketCapitalization. Base input to the Barra SIZE factor loading (size_zscore).

date.description: The snapshot's trading day, YYYY-MM-DD (the {date} path segment).

momentum_20d_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of momentum_20d (winsorized ±3σ). Barra MOMENTUM (short-horizon) loading.

return_60d_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of return_60d (winsorized ±3σ). Barra MOMENTUM (medium-horizon) loading.

mom_12_1_pct_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of mom_12_1_pct (winsorized ±3σ). Barra MOMENTUM (long-horizon / RSTR) loading — trailing 12-month return excluding the most recent month, the horizon the Jegadeesh-Titman momentum premium is defined over.

beta_60d_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of beta_60d (winsorized ±3σ). Barra BETA loading (market sensitivity).

idio_vol_60d_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of idio_vol_60d (winsorized ±3σ). Barra RESVOL loading (residual / idiosyncratic risk).

realized_vol_63d_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of realized_vol_63d (winsorized ±3σ). Barra VOLATILITY loading (total realized risk).

dist_from_52w_high_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of dist_from_52w_high (winsorized ±3σ). Proximity-to-high / reversal-risk loading.

pe_ratio_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of pe_ratio (winsorized ±3σ). Barra VALUE loading (proxy via 1/PE direction).

roe_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of roe (winsorized ±3σ). Barra QUALITY / profitability loading.

size_zscore.description: Cross-sectional z-score of log(market_cap_raw) (winsorized ±3σ). Barra SIZE loading (config#1142) — completes the institutional Barra factor set.

x-settling-bar.rationale: Ticker-indexed and dated by the path segment, same shape as staging/daily_closes: every indicator in features/{date}/*.parquet reads the last bar, so on a same-day run the whole file is a derivation of the unsettled session (24,961 technical / 3,328 interaction / 508 alternative / 4 macro breaches measured on 2026-09-21). Graded as settling only when the key names the report's trading_day (alpha-engine-config-I11351).
